subject: defining the order of data when plotted

messages.author: e3f5ae2bbb1140ed
messages.subject: defining the order of data when plotted
parts:
Hi
I am creating a bar plot and I would like to retain the order of the
data in the data frame (along the x-axis and the order of the counts
for the y-axis). The data frame contains presummarised data. In the
example below, I would like to keep the order of the people (person)
for the x-axis as it is in the data frame along with the chronological
order of the day. Currently, the data is ordered alphabetically, yet
I have been able to order the days in chronological order using the
'group' option within the aes portion of ggplot.

I have found several posts that indicate the use of 'relevel',
'reorder', or 'factor' but have not been able to determine how to use
these functions correctly.

Any help or suggestions would be greatly appreciated.

Thank you
Emilio

Example:
library(ggplot2)
steve <- c(1,2,3,4,5,6)
amy <- c(2,3,4,5,6,1)
mike <- c(3,4,5,6,1,2)
becky <- c(4,5,6,1,2,3)

data <- data.frame()
data <- rbind(steve, amy, mike, becky)
colnames(data) <- c("mon", "tues", "wed", "thur", "fri", "sat")

TdataM <- melt(t(data))
colname(TdataM) <- c("day", "person", "count")

g <- ggplot(TdataM, aes(person, count, fill=day,
group=interaction("mon", "tues", "wed", "thur", "fri", "sat")))
g <- g + geom_bar(position="stack", stat="identity")
g <- g + scale_fill_discrete(breaks=c("mon", "tues", "wed", "thur",
"fri", "sat"))
g

messages.subject: Re: defining the order of data when plotted
parts:
Emilio, 
I would just change the order of the levels. Reorder only works when you have another continuous variable to order the levels.

library(ggplot2)
steve <- c(1,2,3,4,5,6)
amy <- c(2,3,4,5,6,1)
mike <- c(3,4,5,6,1,2)
becky <- c(4,5,6,1,2,3)

data <- data.frame()
data <- rbind(steve, amy, mike, becky)
colnames(data) <- c("mon", "tues", "wed", "thur", "fri", "sat")

TdataM <- melt(t(data))

colnames(TdataM) <- c("day", "person", "count")
TdataM$person <- factor(TdataM$person, levels = c("steve", "amy", "mike", "becky"))
TdataM$day <- factor(TdataM$day, levels = c("mon", "tues", "wed", "thur", "fri", "sat"))

g <- ggplot(TdataM, aes(person, count, fill=day))

g <- g + scale_fill_discrete()

Luciano
